class.name: TerrainRenderer
class.brief_description: Draws the clipmap directly through the [RenderingServer].
class.description: Owns the mesh, shader, and per-level instance and material RIDs itself rather than going through scene nodes, and builds the nested ring hierarchy from [member TerrainConfiguration.clipmap_levels]. Every frame it re-snaps and re-scales each level around the focus point [Terrain3D] hands it, so the finest geometry always sits under the viewer. The terrain shader is read from [code]res://addons/terrain_server/shaders/terrain.gdshader[/code] at runtime rather than compiled into the extension, so shader edits need no rebuild. The loaded shader RID is reused across ordinary configuration edits; [method Terrain3D.reload_shader] forces a re-read from disk. Owned and driven by [Terrain3D]. Because it holds raw [RenderingServer] RIDs that are not freed automatically, it should not be instantiated or torn down by hand.
